narration:3:1521012001:0.text: Moments later, the door swings open. Abundius steps out, dressed in commoner clothes.

say:6:1521012003:0.text: This is heavier than I thought...

say:7:1521012004:0.text: Come help me with this. I'm heading out.

Hey! What are you...

say:11:1521012007:1.text: Gala opens the bundle, revealing a surprising amount of bread and clothing tucked inside...

say:16:1521012011:0.text: Are you done? Then hand it back.
say:16:1521012011:0.source_cn: 看够了吗？看够了就把包裹还给我。

say:17:1521012012:0.source_cn: 那么，你为什么要换衣服？

say:18:1521012013:0.text: Running around like this will just get your guards in trouble.

say:19:1521012014:0.source_cn: 我留下了一封信，让他们都不要来找我。
